name: Kingston University
description:
Kingston University London (KUL) is a public research university situated in the Royal Borough of Kingston upon Thames, South West London. It was granted college status in 1992, before that it was known as Kingston Polytechnic. Its origins, however, go back to the Kingston Technical Institute, which was established in 1899. 

Located on the edges of one of the most bustling and exciting cities in the world, it is ranked among the top-ten universities in London in 2019's Guardian League Table. It also has a strong reputation in the fields of design, fashion, journalism, pharmacy and sports science.

What is the Kingston University acceptance rate for International Students?

The Kingston University acceptance rate is 20-30%.

Student Life

Students at Kingston University have free access to its Kingston Language scheme. This means you can improve your language skills with a choice of European and international languages including: French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Mandarin, Japanese and Arabic.

The university has invested Â£123 million across its campuses to offer an excellent learning environment complemented by all the latest equipment and facilities. It also has close links with external bodies to ensure easy access to subject-specific resources.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
Kingston University London (KUL) is a public research university in the Royal Borough of Kingston upon Thames, South West London. Before becoming a university, it was known as Kingston Polytechnic.

It’s been ranked in the top 60 universities in the UK by The Guardian University Guide for several years and has also won a Guardian Teaching Excellence award. It’s renowned for its strong academic programs, particularly in graphic design, product design, business, economics, fashion, journalism, pharmacy, and many more.

highlights.title: Student Life
highlights.value:
At Kingston University, student life is dynamic and inclusive. With 18,000 students, including 3,000 international students from over 140 countries, you’ll find a vibrant community. You can choose from over 100 societies and 35+ sports clubs. Plus, as a student, you get free access to Kingston’s Language Scheme, offering languages like French, Spanish, Mandarin, and more, perfect for expanding your skills.

Not just that, the university offers flexible and confidential services tailored to your individual needs, including health services, disability support, and mental health resources. On-campus medical support is available, along with guidance on registering with local general practitioners.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Kingston University offers a range of on-campus accommodation options. Whether you prefer a shared flat or a private room, you’ll find modern, comfortable spaces to call home. All on-campus accommodation is just a short walk or bus ride from campus.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
The university's library has extensive collections of books, journals, and digital resources. With quiet study areas and group workspaces, it’s the perfect place to focus on your studies or research.

Sports
If you're into sports, Kingston has a lot for you. From a well-equipped fitness centre to outdoor pitches and indoor courts, the university offers top-notch facilities for both recreational and competitive sports. With over 35 sports clubs, you’ll have plenty of opportunities to stay active.

Laboratory
Kingston University provides state-of-the-art labs with the latest technology for science, engineering, and design. These include the Architectural Science and Technology Laboratory (ArchiLab), Film and media facilities, Visconti Studio, and many more. Moreover, the Kingston School of Art has state-of-the-art facilities, including modern studios, workshops, and the Moving Image Workshop.

Cafeteria
The campus features a variety of cafes and eateries offering everything from hot meals to grab-and-go snacks. The canteen at Penrhyn Road, known as the Marketplace, has a wide selection of food and soft drinks. Similarly, the Foodstore at Kingston Hill is another spot, whether you're looking for a quick snack or a full meal.
